title: On-expiry curve for a calendar drawn from the model (G-14-3, same fix as RD-078)
reference_behaviour: For a calendar, the on-expiry line is valued by the model at the first expiry and drawn as a curve, with a note that the loss can exceed the max loss shown.
ours: SPEC CHANGE: the engine refuses mixed-expiry scenarios; REQ-083 says a chart on different expiries carries a reason instead, and REQ-081 AC-4 shows no maximum (ADR-143).
